authorial_core.baseline_prompt_en: A candid photograph from a fictional music idol's working day, showing a fictional woman performer in an idol-related encounter. Use the supplied portrait as a reference for the visible face and hair appearance: the short dark bob, wispy parted bangs, softly tapered face, large dark eyes and natural lip shape. The imagined performer is 24 years old; the scene is an independently conceived fan video call in a modest tour dressing room at a community arts venue. She sits at the left side of a narrow vanity wearing a dusty-rose tailored stage jacket with a small silver star embroidered on the lapel, a charcoal top, and a thin ear microphone resting along her cheek. Warm practical mirror bulbs and cool corridor spill catch the dark hair and the jacket's soft sheen. The performance has just ended, her jacket sleeve slightly rumpled and a folded stage towel beside the mirror. At the right side of the vanity, a tablet on a stable stand displays one clearly visible fan in a live call. The fan holds a rose-colored album with the same silver star emblem upright at chest level and raises the other hand in a small farewell wave. A small call timer reads 00:08 near the top of the display. The performer is looking at the fan's face on the screen, chin gently lowered in a reassuring nod, her expression softening into a small affectionate smile. Her left forearm rests naturally on the vanity; her right elbow stays close to her side as she lifts her right palm toward the tablet in a relaxed answering wave. Keep the physical tablet, the displayed fan, the fan's raised hand and album, and the performer's answering palm legible together. The two people are separated by the screen surface and linked by their mutual farewell attention. A compact tour pass and a corner of a small performance poster beside the mirror repeat the silver star, while a charcoal garment bag hangs farther back. Photograph from the open side of the vanity at seated eye level, a medium-wide horizontal frame: the performer occupies the left half in a readable three-quarter view, and the tablet occupies the right foreground with its screen turned obliquely toward both her and the camera. Her face, right hand and the active screen share useful focus; the dressing-room doorway falls softly behind. The attraction is understated and personal, carried by attentive eyes, the small smile and the pause before goodbye. Keep this as one observed closing moment, with natural skin texture, believable screen luminance and the intimacy of a fan receiving a final few seconds of attention.
